newsitem.title: USA: Marathon Oil sells Alaska Crude interests.
newsitem.headline: Marathon Oil sells Alaska Crude interests.

text.p: Marathon Oil Co said it has signed an agreement for the sale of certain oil producing properties in Cook Inlet and Prudhoe Bay, Alaska to Forcenergy Inc.
The sale includes Marathon's equity in the Cook Inlet Pipeline and Drift River Terminal, which are used to gather and transport crude oil on the west side of Cook Inlet.

Marathon said it is selling working interests in oil producing properties of McArthur River Field and Trading Bay Field in Cook Inlet, and the Prudhoe Bay Unit, some of which are subject to preferential rights held by third parties.

The producing properties in the Cook Inlet area, the Cook Inlet Pipeline and Drift River Terminal are operated by Unocal Corp. The Prudhoe Bay Unit is operated by British Petroleum Co Plc and Atlantic Richfield Co. Net production from the interests to be sold is approximately 7,200 barrels of oil per day.
None of Marathon's significant natural gas assets were sold in this transaction, it said
